mapper.select: select count(*) from ct_contract c join sp_supplier s on s.id=c.supplier_id where

select cast(c.id as char) id,c.contract_no contractNo,c.name,cast(c.supplier_id as char) supplierId, s.name supplier,c.type,c.amount,c.signed_date signedDate,c.start_date startDate,c.end_date endDate, c.status,cast(c.purchase_order_id as char) purchaseOrderId,o.order_no orderNo, c.created_at createdAt from ct_contract c join sp_supplier s on s.id=c.supplier_id left join po_purchase_order o on o.id=c.purchase_order_id where order by c.id desc limit #{size} offset #{offset}

select cast(c.id as char) id,c.contract_no contractNo,c.name,cast(c.supplier_id as char) supplierId, s.name supplier,c.type,c.amount,c.signed_date signedDate,c.start_date startDate,c.end_date endDate, c.status,cast(c.purchase_order_id as char) purchaseOrderId,o.order_no orderNo, cast(c.file_id as char) fileId,f.original_name fileName,c.remark,c.created_at createdAt from ct_contract c join sp_supplier s on s.id=c.supplier_id left join po_purchase_order o on o.id=c.purchase_order_id left join fs_file_metadata f on f.id=c.file_id and f.deleted=0 where c.id=#{id} and c.deleted=0
select id from ct_contract where contract_no=#{contractNo}
mapper.update: update ct_contract set name=#{name},supplier_id=#{supplierId}, purchase_order_id=#{purchaseOrderId,jdbcType=BIGINT},type=#{type},amount=#{amount}, signed_date=#{signedDate,jdbcType=DATE},start_date=#{startDate,jdbcType=DATE}, end_date=#{endDate,jdbcType=DATE},file_id=#{fileId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, remark=#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR},updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id} and deleted=0
update ct_contract set status='ACTIVE',updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id}
update ct_contract set status='TERMINATED',updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id}
update ct_contract set deleted=1,updated_by=#{userId} where id=#{id}
update ct_contract set status='EXPIRED' where status='ACTIVE' and end_date is not null and end_date<curdate() and deleted=0
mapper.select: select status,deleted from ct_contract where id=#{id} and deleted=0
select count(*) from sp_supplier where id=#{supplierId} and deleted=0
select supplier_id from po_purchase_order where id=#{purchaseOrderId} and deleted=0
